facts.fact: Malawi officials say the Department of Human Resource Management, the Ministry of Agriculture and the Ministry of Health systems are connected to the NRIS infrastructure and have registered positive results, and that all government systems are to be connected to NRIS for anti-fraud verification; the article does not say these systems check people against the ID.
